messages:
Ana: Heads-up: noticed a small but consistent mismatch — console shows ~400 reqs attributed to project:unknown for org-quasar over the last 20m. Billing team flagged a tiny delta in chargeback.
Vik: any sample req id or edge?
Ana: sample 9f8e7d - eu-west-1. Logs show `x-origin-project: data-pipeline` earlier in the chain but router picked projectless.
Sam: can you paste the quicklog?
Ana: sure:
```
ts=1795554310 req=9f8e7d headers={x-origin-project:data-pipeline} auth_introspect={status:502, body:"error"} routing_path=fallback:org-only
```
Priya: 502 from introspect again. Seems like the router falls back immediately and our telemetry marks those as fully projectless which skews ratebands and billing buckets.
Vik: short fix: tag events with `attr_origin=header|introspect` and `attr_confidence=high|soft|unknown`. That way console can show "soft attribution (header only)" and accounting can exclude soft from billable aggregation until confirmed.
Ana: I like that. We should also add an audit message whenever a soft-attributed request later gets reconciled to a project so the billing system can retro-charge. Something like publish to topic `billing-reassign` with {req, old_attr, new_attr, reconciled_at}.
Sam: agree. Implementation plan idea:
- telemetry (2h): add attr_origin, attr_confidence, and a lightweight `attr_tag` for tooling (owner: Sam).
- reconciliation worker (1w): spin up `attr-janitor` job that listens to auth events and reconciles soft -> authoritative claims after 24h, publishing reassign messages. (owner: Priya)
- console UX (3d): show yellow badge and an action menu: "Pin this project (instant, requires billing confirmation)". (owner: Vik)
Priya: accounting asks for a 48h default hold window before retro-charge; maybe make it configurable per org and document in docs. Also require an audit event for any pin override.
Vik: good point. For the pin flow, require org-admin confirmation and append a signed acknowledgment to the audit entry.
Ana: ops: can we set an alert for soft attribution ratio > 0.5% for any org over 10m? We want to catch regressions quickly.
ops-bot: created alert rule "soft_attr_ratio" threshold 0.5%/10m, created ticket ENG-9999.
Sam: small schema example we'll ship: "attr_origin":"header","attr_confidence":"soft","attr_tag":"header_preserved_on_introspect_fail"
Priya: attr-janitor design: consumes auth-change stream, for each soft event look up later introspect confirmation up to 48h, if confirmed publish billing-reassign and write audit row. We'll make reconciliation idempotent.
Vik: UX: console will show an inline tooltip: "Soft attribution = header seen but not yet verified. Click pin to force billing link (requires consent)." Product wants a CTA label "Request billing pin" if not admin.
Ana: timeline: telemetry + alert today (Sam + ops), UX quick mock tomorrow (Vik), janitor prototype next week (Priya). I'll open RFC and track owners.
Priya: I'll also add a retention policy for audit events (7 years?) for compliance.
Sam: will send telemetry PR shortly and update log-parsers.
Vik: drafting UX mock now.
Ana: thanks all. Keeping this thread open until janitor is running and console pin is gated behind legal sign-off. :thumbsup:
